# Current Frog Path

![Current Frog Path function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/path/10-constante-chemin.svg)

[Path functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Context constant returning the full Path of the containing .frog file, including its filename. Resolution follows that document, not the selected window or its caller; later evaluations follow Rename or Save As. An unsaved document or unavailable deployed source path reports an explicit unavailable-context diagnostic. It never substitutes a directory, current process directory or development-machine path.

## Types and connection rules
